## What it is
Post-Trap Futurism Radio plays That Boy Hi Hat's Post-Trap Futurism catalog in the browser:
track 1 "Zooted Zone" (3:06, KingCode pick), a signal queue of entry points
(tap a cover to take over the broadcast), an agent relay for logging field notes,
and a link-out to the 24-track AI Learning Set (Spotify).

## Facts (verified 2026-09-29)
- Catalog snapshot: 2026-09-15
- "Zooted Zone" lifetime Spotify plays: 307,439 (observed 2026-09-14)
- No listener metrics claimed; the station is new.
- Explicit recordings; headphones recommended.
